evidence.evidence: Rachel Kalisher Assistant Professor rkalisher@ucsd.edu Rachel Kalisher is a bioarchaeologist exploring kinship and maternity in the ancient past. She earned her PhD from Brown University with a concurrent ScM in Ecology, Evolution and Organismal Biology. She also holds an MA in Human Skeletal Biology from New York University. At UCSD, she runs the Bioarchaeology and Skeletal Physiology Lab, which aims to reconstruct life history events through skeletal and dental records.
